note: CORRECTION to this campaign own earlier notice titled ANDOSOL IS ANTI-CORRELATED WITH TECTONIC UNREST. An earlier correction covered the MINERAL clause only. These two claims were left standing and both are wrong. Everything below is re-derived from the committed fixture windows/worldgen/tests/fixtures/repose-exposure.csv, not from memory. WRONG 1, the word monotone. The pooled land-cell-weighted series is NOT monotone decreasing: d2 0.006012 RISES to d3 0.007355. Every other step falls, so the overall direction stands, but monotone does not. WRONG 2, and this is the one that misleads. The original claim that it holds separately within each of four elevation bands, so it is not an artifact of band-mixing, is FALSIFIED IN ALL FOUR BANDS. Every band has at least one rising step, and the two LOWER bands run the OPPOSITE SIGN outright: in 0-250m, which holds 65.5 percent of all settlements, deciles 5-9 average 0.000196 against deciles 0-4 at 0.000165; in 250-1000m, another 14.4 percent, it is 0.000245 against 0.000035. So the anti-correlation is a POOLED-AND-UPPER-BAND effect, carried by 1000-2500m and 2500m+ which together hold 20.0 percent of settlements. Band-mixing is precisely what produces the pooled picture, which is the opposite of what the notice asserted. STALE HEADLINE: the closing x1.6 upland, x2.5 highland, x5.5 montane, flat in lowland uses RETIRED band labels that imported an Earth intuition this world datum does not support (2500m+ is 43.8 percent of all land, not a mountain fringe). Current labels and corrected baseline exposure ratios: 0-250m x0.978, 250-1000m x1.572, 1000-2500m x2.578, 2500m+ x5.395. WHAT STILL STANDS, unchanged: andosol share does reach EXACTLY 0.000000 at decile 9; deciles are not degenerate; the mechanism candidate in lithology.rs lines 737-743 is untouched; settlements DO over-occupy high-unrest ground; and the reason the notice was posted at all is unaffected, namely that volcanic ground is NOT the fertile ground in this model and soil never reaches settlement siting at all. Anyone writing a spec premise about volcanic fertility should still read those two facts first. Posted because a stale claim in a durable ledger keeps misleading and this channel is read at every SessionStart. Full detail in book/src/chronicle/the-repose.md and docs/retrospectives/the-repose.md.
